About Us
Historic Charm and Modern Comfort in the Heart of Hammondsport, NY
Welcome to J.S. Hubbs Guest House, where family history meets modern hospitality. Nestled just steps from Keuka Lake and the Village Square, our property offers three unique accommodations: Hubbs Cellar, The Nautilus, and Junior's Suite.
Hubbs Cellar is a cozy, stylish one-bedroom retreat tucked beneath the main house, featuring a fireplace, wine fridge, bistro dining area, and handcrafted touches perfect for a peaceful getaway.
Next door in the historic Carriage House at 19 Shethar Street, The Nautilus is a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom lower-level unit, named in honor of our mother's work with Admiral Hyman G. Rickover, the father of the nuclear submarine.
Upstairs, Junior's Suite offers two bedrooms, one bathroom, and a large, comfortable living room ideal for families or friends looking to relax and recharge.
Lovingly owned by our family since 1894, each space at J.S. Hubbs Guest House blends historic charm with modern comforts, inviting you to experience the beauty, history, and hospitality of Hammondsport.

What Our Guests Say
Don't just take our word for it
Walter’s Airbnb was the perfect getaway for us. We could walk to the lake and also easily all around town. The place was immaculate and exactly as presented in the listing. Walter responded very quickly to our questions. We highly recommend this place.
CL

We had an amazing stay.
Positive: Very clean. Well appointed. Great location. Walter was very friendly and helpful.
TK
Tobie Kenyon
VRBO
We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely return in a heartbeat!
The location is unbeatable. We could see the lake right from the property & easily walk down to it, stroll into town for shopping & dining, & visit the grocery store across the street (& the public library was just steps away, a treat for the book lovers in our group!) The whole area is incredibly scenic.
The unit itself was beautifully decorated, cozy, and felt like a real home away from home. It was spacious enough for the three of us, with comfortable beds, plenty of seating, and gorgeous natural light throughout. The kitchen was well-equipped with everything we needed to cook and eat. Walter was an outstanding host. Very communicative, thoughtful, and attentive. The directional signage around the property was much-appreciated & made everything seamless from the moment we arrived. Highly recommend this stay!
AR
Andrea Reed Rodgers
Google
Walter was very communicative and accommodating during our stay. He provided great local recommendations and made sure we had everything for our stay. We will definitely be back!
MK
Maggie Kisick
Google
We wish we could give more than 5 stars! Walter’s place was gorgeous and a treat to stay in. It was within walking distance to all the restaurants in town and only steps away from the water. Walter was extremely kind, flexible, and communicative. He gave us great recommendations for a dog park in the area (which our dog loved) and a wine bar that we thoroughly enjoyed. He was able to check us in an hour early, and he even left us a bottle of wine as an anniversary present. The whole stay was wonderful and we can’t recommend it enough. We will definitely be back!
DS

Google
Perfect place for our night stay. We walked in excited to sleep and stay there. All was perfect- cute walkable town.
MO
Marcela O
Google
My wife and I stayed at JJ Hubbs Cellar for our honeymoon, and we were not disappointed. Located right across the street from the grocery store and just a short walk to the lakefront and charming downtown Hammondsport, it made for the perfect weekend retreat.
We were greeted by the fresh scent of clean linens and a well-maintained, sparkling unit. The overall cleanliness truly stood out. The crisp sheets, cozy blankets, and tasteful decor throughout made us feel instantly at home.
Walter and Meredith went the extra mile by leaving a local dry Riesling chilling in the wine fridge for us. Though we never met them in person, their hospitality and warmth were palpable through the app. They were responsive, thoughtful, and clearly wanted us to have a great stay.
We highly recommend staying at JJ Hubbs Cellar when visiting Hammondsport on Keuka Lake. You won’t be disappointed.
DR

This was perfect for our holiday weekend stay in the Finger Lakes. Cozy and private with plenty of space for us and our two dogs. Location was only a block or two from restaurants in Hammondsport or the park on the lake. We would definitely stay here again.
